summary: Organigram Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, providing a news release announcing its second quarter fiscal 2026 earnings results to be reported on May 12, 2026. The filing includes details for a conference call and webcast to discuss the results. No transaction, special situation, or corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is disclosed. This is a routine earnings announcement and notice of investor call, which does not constitute a special situation under the classification criteria.
